result.evidence_quote: Using reflexive thematic analysis, we examined semi-structured interviews with 11 UK-based women (aged 33–63) who underwent bariatric surgery (2012–2021) and subsequently developed problematic alcohol use, despite no formal diagnosis of alcohol use disorder.
result.rationale: The study examines psychosocial drivers of problematic alcohol use after bariatric surgery. It does not investigate cardiovascular disease, cardiovascular risk prediction or prevention, or therapies evaluated for cardiovascular outcomes.
